Method of Attack: Privilege escalation exploit of CVE-2022-23176 to build botnet
Persistence via firmware updates injecting malicious code and repacked firmware images
Modular malware enabling upgrades and targeting new devices and vulnerabilities
Discoverer: US and UK cybersecurity and law enforcement agencies
Impacted Systems: WatchGuard Small Office/Home Office (SOHO) network devices
Attack Vector: Exploiting exposed management access on WatchGuard appliances configured for unrestricted Internet management access
Use of infected devices' legitimate firmware update channels
Indicators of Compromise: Infected Firebox devices acting as bots
Command and control servers used by malware
Date of Discovery: May 2022 (CVE-2022-23176 added to CISA catalog in 2022)
